Tap any spot on the map to see its element fingerprint (3 × 3 pixel mean, display level 0–255 within this sample).
Element maps are X-ray window counts, not concentrations: brightness compares the same element across this sample, not one element with another. Mineral suggestions are rules of thumb from the fingerprint; check them against the hand sample.
